question: If cot θ = cot 30° × cot 60° and θ is an acute angle, then 2θ is equal to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: cot θ = cot 30° × cot 60°

Since cot 30° = √3 and cot 60° = 1/√3

cot θ = √3 × (1/√3) = 1

For acute angle θ, cot θ = 1 ⇒ θ = 45°

Value of 2θ = 2 × 45° = 90°

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** cot θ = cot 30° × cot 60°

**Formula Used:** cot 30° = √3; cot 60° = 1/√3; cot 45° = 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/563eaa5d7f4777485354c9b989c4ce7a79ff97df40be1f9e6751e28d1fe154de.png] 

⇒ cot θ = √3 × (1/√3)

⇒ cot θ = 1

⇒ cot θ = cot 45°

⇒ θ = 45°

⇒ 2θ = 2 × 45°

⇒ 2θ = 90°

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios of Complementary Angles

cot(90° − θ) = tan θ and tan(90° − θ) = cot θ. This implies cot 30° = tan 60° and cot 60° = tan 30°.

Reciprocal Relationship

Since tan θ × cot θ = 1, if cot θ = 1, then tan θ = 1. This occurs at θ = 45° for acute angles.

Specific Values

cot 0° = undefined, cot 30° = √3, cot 45° = 1, cot 60° = 1/√3, cot 90° = 0.</p
